title: The Missing Layer
says: A busy board for the browser. Pick a store, pick a verb, name a thing, touch Do.
what: Every knob is something this tab can already do. The site holds no application and no data; it gives the grammar, and each browser that opens it is one live state.
rule: One screen: no scroll, no navigation. Nothing goes out: the page asks the browser to refuse every address but this site's own, and the board sends nothing anywhere.
how: Touch a store, touch a verb, type into Name and Value, touch Do. The line under the buttons says what happened; the box under it shows what the store holds now. Touching a held thing puts it back into Name and Value. Undo takes back the last thing done, then the one before it.

stores.is: The page itself. Things made here are real elements, shown in the box. They are gone on reload.

verbs.does: Makes an element of the kind in Value (p, button, input, details, ul ...) and gives it the name.
Sets the thing's words to Value.
Sets an attribute, written attribute=value. With nothing after the = the attribute is taken away.
Puts the thing inside the thing named in Value, or at the end of the box when Value is empty.
Says what the thing is: its kind, its words, its attributes.
Takes the thing out of the page.
Takes out everything made here.

stores.is: localStorage. Kept by this browser for this site until cleared; every tab of the site sees it.

verbs.does: Keeps Value under Name.
Reads back what is kept under Name.
Forgets Name.
Forgets everything in this store, including what other pages of this site kept.

stores.is: sessionStorage. Kept for this tab only; survives a reload, gone when the tab closes.

verbs.does: Keeps Value under Name.
Reads back what is kept under Name.
Forgets Name.
Forgets everything in this store.

stores.is: IndexedDB. A database in this browser, here one table called things.

verbs.does: Keeps Value under Name.
Reads back what is kept under Name.
Forgets Name.
Empties the table.

stores.is: Cookies this page can see. Kept by this browser for a year unless removed. The board never sends them; a browser attaches cookies to its own requests to the site.

verbs.does: Sets a cookie called Name holding Value.
Reads the cookie called Name.
Expires the cookie called Name.
Expires every cookie this page can see.

stores.is: The Cache store. Normally holds fetched pages; here each entry is made on the spot from Value, and nothing is fetched.

verbs.does: Stores a response holding Value at an address ending in Name.
Reads the stored response back.
Deletes the stored response.
Deletes the board's whole cache.

stores.is: This tab's history. The address changes and nothing loads; the board only moves among entries it made in this visit.

verbs.does: Adds an entry: the address ends in #Name and the entry carries Value.
Rewrites the current entry in place.
Steps back one entry, never past where this visit began.
Steps forward one entry, if there is one.
Says where the tab is and what the current entry carries.

not wired.why: The browser asks the visitor first.
The browser must fetch a file to register one.

proves: the whole board is on one screen
every store is a knob and shows its own verbs
local storage keeps a thing across a reload
session storage keeps a thing across a reload
the database keeps a thing across a reload
a cookie is kept across a reload
the cache keeps a thing across a reload
a thing made in the page is real, and is gone after a reload
get reads a thing back and remove takes it away
what was done can be undone
clear empties a store and undo brings it back
history moves the address and loads nothing
